findings.summary: runKernelOperation commits advanced lifecycle state even when an effect is journaled as failed
findings.acceptance_criteria: Any failed effect must block state commit, preserve prior authoritative state (or explicit reconcile), and return blocked with a stable code—never advanced/terminal.

findings.summary: Missing effectExecutor synthesizes completed effects and still mutates state
findings.acceptance_criteria: Mutating operations without effectExecutor fail closed; only non-mutating status may omit it; regression tests cover denial and no commit.

findings.summary: assertSingleLifecycleReducer misses arrow/const reducer definitions
findings.acceptance_criteria: Checker flags arrow/assignment/exported reduceLifecycle definitions outside reducer.js; fixture test proves detection.

findings.summary: K2 scope-guard module bans can be bypassed via string concatenation
findings.acceptance_criteria: Detect concatenated require/import toward banned module names or tighten allowlisted K2 file set with regression fixture.

findings.summary: effectExecutor {ok:false} journals failed then still commits reduced success state with no covering test
findings.acceptance_criteria: Add a runtime test where effectExecutor returns {ok:false} and assert blocked/failed outcome, state digest does not advance to the success post-state, and journal records failure without committing the reduced success state.

findings.summary: journal status unknown fail-closed lacks public runKernelOperation integration test
findings.acceptance_criteria: Add runKernelOperation test with initial journal status unknown expecting outcome blocked, code reconciliation-required, and unchanged store state digest/journal material content.

findings.summary: Ambiguous effectExecutor failure leaves journal started and resume blindly re-executes without unknown/fail-closed
findings.acceptance_criteria: Ambiguous executor failure after started must durable-mark unknown (or equivalent) and resume must block with reconciliation-required until exact outcome; started re-execute only when effect is proven not to have run.

findings.summary: Optional commitJournal allows after-effect interrupt to duplicate effects
findings.acceptance_criteria: Require durable journal commits before effect start and after effect completion, or fail-closed when the store cannot provide mid-operation journal durability.

findings.summary: Near-identical interruptAt vs interruptAfter hide distinct barrier vocabularies
findings.acceptance_criteria: Rename to mechanism-revealing names or document each parameter's accepted token vocabulary with examples next to the destructuring.

findings.summary: Silent reconcile→execute remap hides replay-once policy
findings.acceptance_criteria: Emit distinct self-describing journal actions or comment the remap citing the replay invariant and why started is not immediate fail-closed.

findings.summary: Opaque stableSerialize&&JSON.stringify expression in checkSameTransitions
findings.acceptance_criteria: Replace with named clones that state intent and remove decorative stableSerialize&&, or comment why the form is deliberate.

findings.summary: Public barrel re-exports reduceLifecycle blurring core/shell conformance boundary
findings.acceptance_criteria: Stop re-exporting the reducer from the shell barrel, or explicitly label conformance API vs internal/model utilities.
